Insurance Directory

Comprehensive Insurance Portfolio Aligned with NAICOM Guidelines

Explore our structured directory of personal, commercial, marine, and industrial covers. As insurance brokers, we ensure every policy is tailored to your real exposures and placed with authorized underwriters.

Our directory covers 25 core insurance solutions across six main categories. Review specific covers or request an adviser consultation.

Motor Third-Party & Comprehensive

Legal liability and physical damage protection for private motorists and commercial transport fleets.

Marine Cargo & Hull

Protection for ocean, air, and multimodal consignments under Institute Cargo Clauses.

Fire & Special Perils

Safeguarding business premises, warehouses, and plant against fire, storm, and explosion hazards.

Contractors' All Risks (CAR)

Comprehensive construction project insurance covering material damage and third-party liabilities.

Professional Indemnity & D&O

Civil liability defence and management indemnity for corporate directors, lawyers, engineers, and advisers.

Group Life & Personal Accident

Statutory employee death benefit arrangements under Nigerian pension law and injury indemnity.
